fragment.choose:
<when condition="@{
            var model = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", "");
            var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "");
            return model != "non-llm-request" && modelId != "non-llm-request";
        }">
            
                
                
                
                
                <dimension name="deploymentName" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "DefaultModel")))" />
                
                
                
                
                
                <dimension name="appId" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("appId", context.Subscription?.Id ?? "Portal-Admin-Sub"))" />

                
                <dimension name="apiType" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", "openai"))" />

                
                <dimension name="customDimension1" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("customDimension1", "NA"))" />
